name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1909: REG-203 and REG-205 were both filed OPEN with the same reason - retuning a pixel fingerprint needs its own before and after sweep over the whole corpus, and three hand-labelled frames is not a corpus. There are twelve now, labelled by opening the images, with a scorer and a ratchet. The fix is a ceiling: the panel-open rule had a floor on dark gridline columns and none above, and a stash grid is a lattice with a bounded number of them while a dark picture simply has most of its columns dark, so a fire-lit temple satisfied the lattice test as easily as a real panel. Measured on his whole 883-frame hist, tally claims drop from nine to one and that one is the only true positive, with no real panel lost. I concluded the opposite first from the feature table and the measurement overturned it, and my first scorer was blind - two opposite sabotages scored the same on it.
